deviations: Lower-third font is Inter loaded with @remotion/google-fonts, so each render fetches the font from Google Fonts over the network. Uses @remotion/three's <ThreeCanvas> with @react-three/fiber 9.2.0 and three 0.170.0; WebGL runs with Remotion's default --gl setting.
gpu: default / single draw WebGL on the GPU (--gl=angle, ANGLE over Metal), as kamishibai and HyperFrames do; cpu / cpu-single are Remotion's own default (SwiftShader)
